description: Write something into long-term memory so it survives this conversation. Routing is automatic by default: a general statement becomes a semantic fact, a narrated event becomes an episode, a sequence of instructions becomes a procedure. Set `type` only when you want to override that. Returns the id of the stored memory.

confidence.description: How certain this is (0–1). Above 0.9 routes to core memory.

content.description: The memory to store, in plain language.

emotionalWeight.description: Emotional significance (0–1). Detected from the content when omitted.

steps.description: Ordered steps. Required when type is 'procedure'.

type.description: Routing hint. 'auto' (default) decides from the content.

name: zenbrain_store
title: Store a memory
